history.content: Audit my subscriptions and kill the ones I do not use.

From your mail in the last 60 days, I found two active subscriptions: 1. Netflix, $15.49/month, looks in use 2. Audible, $14.95/month, last login 5 months ago That's the full set of subscription receipts I can see, so roughly $30/month total. Audible is the obvious kill candidate, 5 months without opening it. One honest limit: I can't cancel subscriptions for you directly. Fastest routes: Audible: audible.com → Account → Cancel membership (they'll offer a pause deal, hold firm) Netflix: netflix.com → Account → Cancel plan if you want it gone too Want me to draft a cancellation email to Audible support instead, or set a reminder so you don't forget to do it tonight?
